description: Returns sandbox test cards to type into a checkout, filtered by gateway, outcome and brand. Each card includes the number, brand, expected outcome, gateway notes and generic fill values (expiry, CVV, postal code). When gatewayHint contradicts fill values, the hint wins (e.g. Mercado Pago decides the outcome by cardholder name). Returns at most 50 cards (default 10); total tells how many matched.

lang.description: Language for descriptions, notes and hints. Default "en".

name: find_test_cards
title: Find test cards
